limitations: Five selected-part Dev Bullet5/AP0 hits execute original TakeDamage; not weapon accuracy, projectile penetration, hit-distribution or naturally initiated combat. AddHediff was not used in this chapter.
Only two covered head hits, one covered torso hit and two uncovered controls. Full deflection was not observed; no frequency or probability estimate is supported.

The torso Bruise3 and plateHP-1 support diminished Sharp-to-Blunt behavior. Inner shirtHP unchanged does not prove it was skipped: RoundRandom(3*0.25) may be0. Internal RNG and layer events were not traced.
Dev item generation/material/quality preparation is distinct from ordinary wear. Set Stuff resets item HP; preparation detours are recorded, not presented as crafted items.

Underlying shirt/pants Normal Synthread129HP and inherited scar/missing parts were retained. Old Gunshot111 healed5 to4.28000069 during ordinary wear runs; compare adjacent paused saves for each later hit.

Unintended post-experiment run101859 to143638 is retained and excluded from armor inference. It includes natural treatment, healing, nutrition/drug changes and a cat death notification; no controlled claim is made about those events. Failed armor-stopped-a/b are not final pause evidence.
No game files, saveXML, normal profile or skill values edited; no new process, reload, mods, God mode, Dev healing or Dev tending. No temporary work/medCare setting changes.

Portable verification validates retained extraction, identities, action ledger and crops. Local mode rereads raw saves, source captures and metadata; neither mode re-executes gameplay or performs OCR.

Missing quality serializes as Awful for audited CompQuality items, distinct from its Normal constructor default. Reader preserves raw quality and field presence; unknown apparel without quality is not blindly labeled Awful.
